Team —

Technical addendum to the evidence packet, focusing on eval/regression and deployment controls that Sunridge asked about. Key points to include in the deliverables:

- Eval/regression approach:
  * Baseline corpora: We will supply a redacted sample (n=10k tokens) used to establish generation baselines and safety metrics.
  * Sampling & drift detection: monthly stratified sampling across top customer prompt patterns + automated drift alerts (Jensen-Shannon divergence thresholds).
  * Regression harness: deterministic seeds + snapshot tests, differential output checks, and human-in-the-loop review for flagged regressions.

- Canary & rollback policies:
  * Canary routing (1-5% traffic) with latency, error, semantic-quality gates.
  * Automatic rollback when semantic-quality drops by >5% relative to baseline or when error rates exceed configured SLOs.

- Runtime controls & evidence:
  * KV cache and batching metrics included in per-route telemetry (helps explain token cost vs latency trade-offs).
  * Example audit traces that link request->model-variant->response hash for traceability.

I attached a one-page summary of the eval harness. Happy to convert any of this into a runnable notebook for their technical reviewers.

Attachments: eval-harness-summary.md

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Inference
Redwood Inference
